source_refs.title: Send an automatic reply when you're out of office - Computer - Gmail Help
source_refs.verified_excerpt: In most cases, your reply is only sent to people the first time they message you.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On a computer, in Gmail: 1. Open Gmail on your computer. 2. At the top right, click the Settings icon, then click 'See all settings.' 3. On the 'General' tab, scroll to the 'Vacation responder' section. 4. Select 'Vacation responder on.' 5. Enter a date range, a subject, and a message. 6. Optional: To send replies only to your contacts, check the box below the message. 7. At the bottom of the page, click 'Save Changes.'
